description: This file is a shell script that defines a set of tests for handling UTF-16 encoded files without BOM in a Perforce Git integration environment. It sets up a Perforce depot, manipulates files to simulate missing BOM scenarios, and verifies correct cloning behavior.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds a file to Perforce depot with specified file type.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4d
methods.description: Runs the Perforce server in various modes (create checkpoint, restore, etc.).

methods.name: p4d -jc
methods.description: Creates an in-memory journal for the Perforce server.

methods.name: p4d -jrF checkpoint.1
methods.description: Restores the Perforce server from a checkpoint.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Removes temporary Git repositories created during tests.
